candidate.note: The preregistration is written before the prospective run. Its SHA-256 is quoted by the run receipt, and the checker refuses a receipt that does not match it.

template.purpose: Fix the measurement plan before data exists, so that a later reading cannot select a favourable geometry, statistic, control or exclusion after seeing the result.

field_rules.status: PROSPECTIVE when registered before execution, RECONSTRUCTED_POST_HOC when derived from an existing receipt; a reconstructed instance never supports a constant-time claim.
field_rules.hypotheses: One object per hypothesis, each with id, statement and expected outcome.
field_rules.workloads: One object per mode, naming its input classes and operand population.
field_rules.instrument: name, harness path, harness source digest, pinned upstream commit, admissible use and not-its-use list.
field_rules.candidate: The measured artefact digest known at registration, plus the scope note.
field_rules.geometry: per_batch, max_batches, runs, pin and family_size. No value may change after the run.
field_rules.statistic: The exact test, thresholds and the meaning of every verdict state.
field_rules.multiple_comparisons: The declared family and the correction procedure.
field_rules.controls: A positive control that must fire and a negative control that must stay quiet.
field_rules.exclusion_rules: Rules fixed before the run. A post-run change is a refusal.
field_rules.stopping_conditions: The only permitted reasons to stop early.
field_rules.null_result_meaning: What a null result does and does not establish.
field_rules.claim_scope: Artefact, target, profile and whether the result generalises to the release artefact.

hypotheses.statement: The deliberately early-exiting comparison (cmpnaive) separates the two input classes at the registered geometry.
hypotheses.expected: state 0 (DUDECT_LEAKAGE_FOUND) within the registered batch budget

hypotheses.statement: The constant-time reference comparison (cmpcmp) does not separate the two input classes at the registered geometry.
hypotheses.expected: state 1 (DUDECT_NO_LEAKAGE_EVIDENCE_YET) after the full batch budget

hypotheses.statement: If either control leaves its registered direction, the instrument or the geometry is not admitted and the run establishes nothing.

two 4096-byte buffers differing at the last byte
workloads.operand_population: the harness's two fixed comparison pairs; no secret input
workloads.why: an early-exit comparison must turn the mismatch position into a timing difference

instrument.name: dudect
instrument.admissible_use: separating the two registered input classes by timing, at the registered geometry, on the recorded artefact
not_its_use: a constant-time proof for any mechanism
microarchitectural leakage that the statistical test does not exercise
a result for a different artefact or build profile
a result for a mode that was not run

candidate.scope_note: This run is an instrument-control measurement. It is not a constant-time claim about the AES, BN, ECDSA or RSA mechanisms, and the artefact identity is the on-disk DSO, not a source-to-binary correspondence.

statistic.test: Welch t (two-sided), computed by the pinned dudect harness per batch
statistic.state_0_meaning: leakage detected between the compared classes at this geometry
statistic.state_1_meaning: absence of evidence at this geometry; never a proof of constant-time behaviour

multiple_comparisons.procedure: The two modes are directional controls, not competing hypotheses. A Bonferroni threshold of 0.05/2 would be applied to any p-value read from the batch maxima; no such p-value is promoted to a claim.
multiple_comparisons.note: The family is fixed at two modes. Adding a mode after the run is a refusal.

controls.instrument_failure: A positive control that stays quiet, or a negative control that fires, invalidates the run. A control is not evidence if the harness does not report it.

exclusion_rules: No measurement is removed after the run.
A failed operation rejects its measurement; a mode that reports a failed operation is not admitted.
No value-based trimming, winsorising or batch replacement is permitted.
The mode set, per-batch count and batch budget are fixed; no mode may be added after the run.
A run that cannot establish its artefact identity is refused, not reported as a pass.
stopping_conditions: Stop a mode when the harness reports DUDECT_LEAKAGE_FOUND (state 0).
Stop a mode after max_batches when state remains 1.
Abort the run on a build failure, a harness error, or a missing control.
Abort the run when the loaded DSO digest differs from the registered digest.

null_result_meaning.means: No statistically detectable timing class was observed between the registered input classes of that mode at the registered geometry.
does_not_mean: a statement about a different artefact, build profile or CPU
a statement about any mechanism the mode did not measure

claim_scope.artefact: libcrypto.so.3 loaded through the dudect C harness

instances.reconstruction_note: This instance is derived from a receipt that already exists in the tree. It records what the executed geometry was; it is not evidence of prospective registration and it is not used to support any constant-time claim. It exists so that the recorded geometry can be checked against the recorded numbers rather than restated from prose.
